input.quote: EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO THE PARTIES' LIABILITY FOR INDEMNIFICATION, OR LIABILITY FOR BREACH OF CONFIDENTIALITY, NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ANY CONSEQUENTIAL, INCIDENTAL, INDIRECT, PUNITIVE, SPECIAL OR OTHER SIMILAR DAMAGES
input.rationale: Section 7 contains only a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages; there is no aggregate cap of any kind, so our direct liability is unlimited and the fallback (mutual 12-month cap) is not met. We added a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' amounts paid or payable between the Parties and USD 1,000,000, with indemnification, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap (the existing carve-outs for indemnity and confidentiality are preserved). Because this is a revenue-share deal in which Customer pays no fees, the cap basis is expressed as amounts paid or payable between the Parties.
